rationale: Default-off exact-density reuse of completed geometry-only semilocal/nonlocal and nuclear responses within the immutable Python composite compatibility owner. Native one-electron/Pulay response always runs; optional bounded host storage can be refused without changing the endpoint. Public prepared items with native stationary-force capability bypass this owner and do not consume this selector. Their existing native VV10 component reuse and shared-grid defaults are separate policies.
revisit_condition: First identify actual endpoint ownership; forced compatibility hits cannot qualify a native-default speedup. Require independent E/F and displaced-energy gates, actual hits, geometry/one-ULP/resource/failure invalidation and source-bound complete 48/96-atom cold/warm/moved populations before promoting this consumer. The October 14 qualification used the historical VV10 rho>=1e-8 v1 domain, not the current rho>=1e-10 v2 domain; do not relabel those observables as current-domain references. Qualify geometry reuse both alone and with integral-response reuse rather than adding their historical gains.
